_comment: APEX scheduled-event calendar (grok/lip-fixes-20261009). Dates verified 2026-10-09 against the official BLS release schedules (bls.gov/schedule: CPI, PPI, Employment Situation) and the Federal Reserve FOMC calendar (federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm). Times are the official release times (08:30 ET for BLS; 14:00 ET FOMC statement) converted to UTC. Prefix match covers e.g. KXCPI -> KXCPICORE, KXCPIYOY, KXCPICOREYOY. Treasury-yield markets (KX*YRRATE*) are included on every macro release. MAINTAIN: add the 2027 dates before 2026-12-10 or the calendar goes quiet (it does not fail closed on an empty future). Installed at /etc/lip-maker/event_calendar.json; LIP_EVENT_CALENDAR_FILE points to it. An invalid file blocks ALL markets (fail closed).
